baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath verb at word 2 governs the plural object at word 3, whose inventory explicitly includes stars or planets that disappear and return.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance binds sworn testimony to wandering lights whose diagnostic behavior is intermittent visibility. Their absence is part of how they are recognized, so concealment does not cancel their evidentiary force.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch supplies the explicit act of sworn attestation.
The hiding-and-returning celestial branch supplies mobile witnesses defined by recurrent loss from view.

changed_reading.before: A generic oath by obscure entities.
changed_reading.after: An oath by wandering lights whose repeated disappearance and return make them legible witnesses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3 also names withdrawal into concealment or delay without requiring a celestial referent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath points not only to hidden objects but to the act of receding, contracting, delaying, or withholding. It creates a productive tension in which absence itself is summoned as testimony.

activation_trace.role: Sworn attestation establishes the evidentiary frame.
Withdrawal into concealment or delay makes recession, rather than a fixed object class, the oath's marked phenomenon.

changed_reading.before: The plural is merely an unidentified class of things.
changed_reading.after: The plural concentrates an action-pattern: presences contract, hide, or arrive late, and that pattern bears witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inventory for word 3 independently includes antelopes and their place of cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath can retain an ecological co-reading in which alert animals vanish into protective cover. The marked feature is embodied retreat to refuge, not astronomical retrogression.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch makes the animals or their refuge valid objects of invocation.
The antelope-and-cover branch supplies an animate refuge scene that can coexist with the celestial reading.

changed_reading.before: The oath must concern celestial bodies.
changed_reading.after: The oath can also concern wary animals characterized by disappearance into cover.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root at word 2 carries both oath-taking and apportionment, while word 3 carries delayed or concealed withdrawal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Beneath the overt oath syntax lies an allocation schema: a whole is divided into shares while one share, right, or presence is held back. This does not replace the oath sense; it gives the oath a latent distributive pressure.

activation_trace.role: The apportionment branch supplies division into distinct shares.
The oath branch keeps the distributive shadow attached to an actual sworn utterance.
Concealment or delay supplies the withheld portion in the allocation model.

changed_reading.before: The oath only intensifies an assertion.
changed_reading.after: The oath also shadows an act of separating what is allotted and visible from what has been delayed or withheld.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two distant but explicit focus branches join a mind divided among courses at word 2 to a running horse that veers at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: While the surface remains an oath, its roots can generate a trajectory model: deliberation splits the available courses and motion then bends away from one of them. The plural may therefore carry a shadow of unstable direction.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch preserves the surface construction while more distant branches activate underneath it.
The divided-mind branch supplies competing courses before movement is chosen.
The veering-horse branch turns inward division into a visible deviation during motion.

changed_reading.before: The oath concerns bodies that simply become hidden.
changed_reading.after: The oath also carries a branch-distant image of trajectories that hesitate, turn aside, or fail to hold a course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence gives the celestial baseline a complete kinetic cycle: a compressed cosmic order, rising stars that plunge or scatter, then bodies that flow and enter planetary hiding places. The focus retreat is therefore a phase of a trajectory rather than a static property.

activation_trace.role: Celestial hiding and return supplies the focus phase that the context expands.
Winding and compressing supplies a cosmic contraction before the focus.
The rising-star image identifies celestial actors capable of alternating appearance and disappearance.
Scattered plunging or falling adds violent directional change to the stars' motion.
Flowing or coursing turns the focus retreaters into bodies moving along a path.
Planetary disappearance into hiding places completes the course-to-concealment cycle.

structural_cues: 81:15 follows the destabilization of sun and stars, while 81:16 continues with two plural descriptors without naming a fresh subject.
The plural focus noun and the two plurals in 81:16 form a compact retreat-course-hide progression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compression, stars, plunging, coursing, and planetary hiding; I infer that these stages belong to one recurring trajectory centered on the focus retreat; alternatively, the earlier collapse and later course may be parallel cosmic images rather than one continuous orbit.

changed_reading.before: The oath invokes lights that are periodically absent.
changed_reading.after: The oath invokes a visible motion law: celestial bodies emerge, alter course, run, and disappear into concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus inquiry, guilt language, written record, publication, and final presence activate the apportionment side of the oath root. The oath reads like a forensic act that separates shares of liability and restores a delayed claim to the field of testimony.

activation_trace.role: Apportionment supplies the allocation of distinct shares of liability.
The distributed-oath branch gives the allocation a sworn and potentially juridical frame.
Delay or concealment supplies the withheld right or testimony that must be brought back.
Question and demand open the inquiry rather than leaving the injured claim silent.
The guilt branch supplies the substance whose ownership must be adjudicated.
The share-or-lot branch unexpectedly mirrors the focus root's apportionment and sharpens the question of who bears a portion.
The written-sheet branch supplies durable case material.
A writing made open or published moves the record from concealment into review.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness complete the return of evidence to the adjudicative scene.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ء د at 81:8 is used only structurally: a silenced victim is made the grammatical patient of inquiry, without any invented branch citation.
The passive killing question is followed by written sheets being opened and by each self knowing what it brought.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inquiry, guilt, a lexical share, records, publication, and presence; I infer that focus apportionment reallocates liability while focus withdrawal marks a delayed claim; alternatively, the share branch may be only a lexical echo and the oath may simply attest the judgment scene.

changed_reading.before: The oath swears by things that withdraw from sight.
changed_reading.after: The oath also functions as forensic redistribution: a withheld claim returns, records open, and the victim's absent guilt-share is separated from the liability borne elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following pair turns the antelope baseline into a process: open movement is followed by entry into a shelter. The focus no longer merely labels animals or cover; it catches the instant in which exposed motion becomes protected disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Antelopes or their cover supply the animate refuge baseline.
Running or flowing supplies exposed locomotion before concealment.
Entry into a shelter or lair supplies the endpoint and purpose of retreat.

structural_cues: 81:15-16 places three plural descriptors in an uninterrupted oath phrase.
No explicit noun forces the sequence to choose between celestial bodies and animals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies antelopes or cover, running, and entry into shelter; I infer an exposed-run-to-refuge sequence; alternatively, shelter is a spatial analogy for planetary disappearance rather than an animal scene.

changed_reading.before: The antelope branch merely offers a second possible referent.
changed_reading.after: The antelope reading becomes a coherent event: beings course through exposure and then disappear into protective cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal is recast as one half of a temporal respiration. Darkness thins at an edge, then dawn opens and exhales; the focus contraction is not terminal loss but pressure gathering before renewed visibility.

activation_trace.role: Contraction and concealment supply the inward phase of the cycle.
Thin darkness at either edge of night supplies a reversible threshold rather than a fixed black interval.
Breath or breeze exiting an interior supplies the outward release after contraction.
The opening of dawn like a breath explicitly scales bodily respiration to the temporal horizon.

structural_cues: The oath chain moves directly from retreating entities to night under an idha-clause and then dawn under a matching idha-clause.
The two temporal clauses balance darkness and dawn as successive phases.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contraction, edge-thinning darkness, outward breath, and dawn-opening; I infer a contraction-to-release rhythm in which retreat enables reappearance; alternatively, the images may be successive witnesses with no causal respiration between them.

changed_reading.before: Retreat means only disappearance from view.
changed_reading.after: Retreat becomes the inward phase of a cosmic breath, followed by the horizon's release into dawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two sides of the focus establish a controlled transfer from hidden to manifest: records open, covering is removed, knowledge dawns, a trusted utterance is seen at a clear horizon, and unseen content is not withheld. The retreating signs become a model of reliable disclosure through, rather than despite, intervals of invisibility.

activation_trace.role: Sworn attestation frames the hidden-to-manifest sequence as a truth claim.
Concealment or delay supplies the epistemic interval the later sequence must traverse.
Opening and spreading supplies the first movement from closure to availability.
Removing a cover and exposing what was hidden makes disclosure materially explicit.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive endpoint of uncovering.
Speech brought outward by articulation turns disclosure into transmissible saying.
Security and settled trust distinguish reliable transmission from merely appearing speech.
Vision by eye or insight supplies direct perceptual attestation after concealment.
Manifest appearance supplies the clear horizon as the opposite pole of withdrawal.
Hiddenness from eyes names the content-domain whose transmission is at issue.
Holding back or hoarding supplies the denied failure mode: hidden content is not permanently withheld.

structural_cues: Before the focus, repeated passives culminate in self-knowledge; after it, explicit negations reject madness, withholding, and a rejected source.
81:23-24 places clear visual manifestation immediately beside discourse about the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, uncovering, knowing, voiced speech, trust, sight, manifestation, hiddenness, and non-withholding; I infer that the focus retreat models a trustworthy passage through temporary invisibility; alternatively, the celestial oath may only certify the message without depicting its disclosure process.

changed_reading.before: Hidden celestial bodies serve as remote objects used to certify a later statement.
changed_reading.after: Their retreat-and-return enacts the epistemic claim itself: reliable disclosure can cross hiddenness without becoming suppression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late destination question and straightening language activate the focus branches of divided deliberation and a horse veering in its run. Cosmic or animal trajectories become a mirror for volitional direction: one can bend away, choose a path, or be brought into alignment within a larger will.

activation_trace.role: A mind divided among courses supplies deliberation before directional choice.
A running horse that veers supplies the embodied image of deviation during movement.
Path, destination, and manner turn the rhetorical question into an inquiry about course.
Will directed toward a thing supplies volitional selection of a course.
Straightness, balance, and alignment supply the corrective alternative to veering.
The repeated willing branch nests human direction inside a larger determining will.

structural_cues: 81:26 directly asks where the hearers are going, and 81:28 answers with an infinitive of becoming straight.
81:29 places human willing and divine willing in the same negative-exceptive construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divided deliberation, veering motion, path, will, and straightness; I infer that the focus motion schema is mapped onto ethical and volitional trajectory; alternatively, the closing appeal may draw a lesson from the oath without redefining its retreaters.

changed_reading.before: Veering is only an odd lexical shadow inside the focus roots.
changed_reading.after: Veering becomes a live image of human direction, answered by the possibility of choosing straight alignment under a larger will.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare cloth-folding branch beneath an ordinary oath verb and assigns it compositional force. It remains valid as a lexical shadow anchored at focus word 2 and reinforced by exact folding, opening, and stripping branches around the focus. Downstream prose should present it as a structural analogy, not as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The oath root at word 2 includes the technical image of making a first fold in cloth.

activation_trace.role: The first-fold branch lets the focus occupy a formal crease in the surah's sequence.
Winding and compacting supplies the large-scale folded material before the focus.
Opening and spreading reverses compression and begins an unfolding movement.
Stripping away a cover reinforces the passage from folded concealment to exposure.

changed_reading.before: 81:15 merely begins a new oath after the opening portents.
changed_reading.after: The oath is also a first-fold pivot: compressed creation and opened records are refolded into a compact proof that then unfolds as revelation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it supplies a predator-prey arrow that the syntax never states. It remains anchored because consecutive packet branches give antelopes or cover, running, shelter-entry, and a wolf prowling at night. Downstream prose should keep it as a possible ecological activation of the sequence, not assert that the oath's referents are definitively hunted antelopes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus plural at word 3 has an explicit antelope-or-cover branch.

activation_trace.role: Antelopes and their refuge supply the threatened animate subjects.
Running supplies rapid exposed movement consistent with flight.
Entry into shelter supplies refuge as the movement's endpoint.
A wolf circling and seeking at night supplies a possible pressure that causes the run to cover.

changed_reading.before: The animal reading is a static alternative label for the focus plural.
changed_reading.after: The sequence can briefly stage a nocturnal ecology of pursuit: wary animals run, enter cover, and remain concealed while a predator searches.

strongest_changes: 81:16 converts retreat from a static trait into a course-to-concealment cycle while preserving both celestial and animal realizations.
The opening of records and the later contrast between clear sight, unseen content, and non-withholding turn the oath into a model of attested disclosure through temporary hiddenness.
The inquiry into guilt, including the unexpected share branch of ذ ن ب, activates ق س م as forensic apportionment of liability rather than oath alone.
The closing destination, will, and straightness language makes the focus's divided-course and veering branches newly legible as a model of human direction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus joins two unusually divergent inventories: oath, apportionment, divided deliberation, and first-fold imagery at word 2; concealment, planets, antelopes, and veering at word 3. The context activates several of these mechanisms independently, so celestial, ecological, forensic, epistemic, temporal, and volitional readings remain coexistent rather than collapsing into one referent.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 81:16 strictly identifies the focus plural or adds parallel descriptors without fixing a referent.
Whether the nocturnal predator-refuge chain is a live ecological mechanism or only accidental adjacency among distant branches.
How much interpretive weight the non-oath branches of ق س م can bear before they should be treated only as lexical shadows.
Whether the retreat-and-return pattern models revelation itself or merely supplies an external oath that certifies it.
